keys: Симулятор российского завода — от гаража до гиганта
en: A Russian factory simulator — from a garage to a giant

keys: шрифты IBM Plex Sans (SIL OFL) и DejaVu Sans
en: fonts: IBM Plex Sans (SIL OFL) and DejaVu Sans

keys: Меню и „Создать рабочего“ не тормозят со временем
en: The menu and “Create a Worker” no longer slow down over time

keys: F3 в меню — строка диагностики (кадры, узлы, память)
en: F3 in the menu shows a diagnostics line (frames, nodes, memory)

keys: Баланс: больше стартовых денег, дешевле стройка
en: Balance: more starting money, cheaper construction

keys: Первые две недели клиенты платят аванс 30%
en: For the first two weeks customers pay a 30% advance
Starting capital depends on the difficulty

keys: Интро при запуске и английский язык (Настройки → Язык)
en: Intro on launch and English language (Settings → Language)

keys: Придумайте название и соберите эмблему: они будут в шапке игры, на вывеске у ворот, в заводской многотиражке и на табличках в цехе. Поменять можно потом — щелчком по эмблеме в шапке.
en: Pick a name and design an emblem: they'll appear in the top bar, on the sign over the gate, in the factory newspaper and on the plaques in the shop. You can change them later by clicking the emblem in the top bar.

keys: Сохранения и настройки лежат в папке пользователя:
en: Saves and settings are stored in the user folder:

keys: Ускорять ночь и выходные, когда на заводе пусто
en: Speed up nights and weekends when the plant is empty

keys: Ставить паузу, когда приходит событие с выбором
en: Pause when an event with a choice arrives

keys: Двигать камеру, когда курсор у края экрана
en: Scroll the camera when the cursor is at the screen edge
Surnames under people on the map

keys: Сколько реальных секунд длится игровой час на обычной скорости
en: How many real seconds a game hour lasts at normal speed

keys: По времени суток: утром — бодрее, днём — рабочий ритм, в аврал — марш, ночью — тихо
en: By time of day: livelier in the morning, a working beat by day, a march during a rush job, quiet at night

keys: Искры, стружка, пар, дым, листья и облака. На слабых компьютерах поставьте пониже
en: Sparks, chips, steam, smoke, leaves and clouds. Turn it down on weaker computers

keys: Сколько кадров в секунду рисовать. Без предела — сколько потянет компьютер
en: How many frames per second to draw. Unlimited: as many as your computer can handle

keys: Включите, если картинка «рвётся» по горизонтали. Тогда кадров не больше, чем герц у монитора
en: Turn on if the picture tears horizontally. Frame rate is then capped at your monitor's refresh rate
The game is saved automatically when you exit.

keys: Справочник: все механики игры по разделам (F1)
en: Handbook: every game mechanic, by section (F1)
Money in the account. Latest transactions:

keys:
Репутация %d из 100. Растёт от заказов, сданных вовремя, и падает от опозданий и срывов.
От неё зависят цены и число заказов.
en:
Reputation %d of 100. Rises with orders delivered on time, falls with delays and failures.
It affects prices and the number of orders.

keys: %s — паспорт завода: название и эмблема (нажмите, чтобы изменить).
en: %s — the factory passport: name and emblem (click to change).

keys: Этап %d из %d: «%s». Рейтинг завода: %d из 5 звёзд.
en: Stage %d of %d: “%s”. Factory rating: %d of 5 stars.
And any %d of your choice (%d done):

keys:
Сейчас на заводе %d из %d. Среднее настроение %d.
Нажмите — «Люди» (L).
en:
At the plant now: %d of %d. Average mood %d.
Click for People (L).

keys: На заводе никого — ночь и выходные проматываются быстро
en: Nobody at the plant — nights and weekends fast-forward

keys:
Электросеть: нагрузка %.1f из %d кВт.
Нажмите — меню «Сети» (E).
en:
Power grid: load %.1f of %d kW.
Click for the Utilities menu (E).

%s, %s. %s
Click for the calendar and inspections (C).

keys: Не платим зарплату: долг %s. Люди уходят (%d из %d) — потом завод закроют. Нажмите, чтобы выплатить
en: We're not paying wages: %s owed. People are quitting (%d of %d), then the plant will be shut down. Click to pay

keys: Нет инструмента и денег на него: станки стоят, люди грозят уволиться. Нажмите — снабжение
en: No tools and no money for them: machines are idle, people threaten to quit. Click for Supply

keys: Завод в долгах (%s): репутация падает, новых заказов не берём. Нажмите — финансы
en: The plant is in debt (%s): reputation is falling, no new orders. Click for Finance

keys: Зоны: цех, склад, бытовка, столовая, кабинеты… Рисуются клетками внутри помещений (R)
en: Zones: shop floor, storage, locker room, canteen, offices… Painted cell by cell inside rooms (R)

keys: Планировка: нарисуйте будущий завод на кальке — стены, полы, зоны, станки. Бесплатно, рабочие план не трогают. Потом «Утвердить план» (V)
en: Layout: sketch your future plant on tracing paper — walls, floors, zones, machines. Free; workers don't touch the plan. Then “Approve plan” (V)

keys: Электричество, свет, водопровод, вентиляция, сжатый воздух (E)
en: Electricity, lighting, plumbing, ventilation, compressed air (E)
Cancel blueprints — the money is refunded

keys: Заказы в работе, рынок, контракты, план ПДО
en: Orders in progress, market, contracts, production plan

keys: Станки и ППР, металл и расходники, склад оборудования (P)
en: Machines and maintenance, metal and consumables, equipment store (P)

keys: Сотрудники, найм, обучение, охрана труда, бригады, график, профсоюз (L)
en: Staff, hiring, training, safety, crews, schedule, union (L)

keys: Сводка, отчёты по неделям, кредиты, гранты (F)

en: Office departments, policies and engineering projects (M)

keys: Этап роста завода, рейтинг в звёздах, цели сценария, достижения (G)
en: Growth stage, star rating, scenario goals, achievements (G)

keys: Общежитие, столовая и медпункт, детсад и ДК, заводское радио, кот (H)
en: Dormitory, canteen and first-aid post, kindergarten and culture club, factory radio, the cat (H)

keys: Подобрать форму, знак и цвета наугад
en: Pick a random shape, symbol and colors

keys: Эмблема — в шапке, на вывеске у ворот, в многотиражке и на табличках в цехе.
en: The emblem appears in the top bar, on the gate sign, in the newspaper and on shop plaques.
Up to three letters — for the “Letters” symbol

keys: Так будет на вывеске у ворот
en: This is how the gate sign will look

keys: Соберите своих людей — ФИО, внешность, черты. В новой игре они могут прийти наниматься: в списке кандидатов отмечены ★.
en: Put together your own people — name, looks, traits. In a new game they may come looking for a job: they're marked ★ in the candidate list.

keys: Новая запись: случайные имя и внешность — поменяйте как хотите
en: New entry with a random name and looks — change them as you like

keys: Для каждого включённого, кого ещё нет на заводе, — при каждом обновлении кандидатов (по понедельникам и по объявлению). За раз приходит не больше одного.
en: For each enabled worker not yet at the plant — every time candidates refresh (on Mondays and after a job ad). No more than one arrives at a time.

keys: Как на работе: одежда по профессии
en: As at work: clothes for the trade

keys: Как приходит на завод и уходит домой
en: As when arriving at the plant and going home

keys: Перебрать внешность целиком (ФИО и черты останутся)
en: Re-roll the whole look (name and traits stay)
Remove from the list for good

keys: Включён: может прийти в новой игре
en: Enabled: may turn up in a new game
new — not on the list yet

keys: В списке уже %d — больше нельзя. Удалите кого-нибудь.
en: The list already has %d — that's the limit. Delete someone.

keys: Добавлена в список. В новой игре может прийти наниматься.
en: Added to the list. She may come looking for a job in a new game.

keys: Добавлен в список. В новой игре может прийти наниматься.
en: Added to the list. He may come looking for a job in a new game.
Check the name — errors are marked in red.

keys: Новый рабочий ещё не в списке.
en: The new worker isn't on the list yet.
Pick a surname, first name and patronymic

keys: Русские буквы и дефис, от %d до %d знаков. Пол меняет окончания: Петров → Петрова.
en: Cyrillic letters and hyphens, %d to %d characters. Gender changes the endings: Petrov → Petrova.

keys: Любая — по тому, кто нужен заводу
Без черт — обычный человек. Выберите до двух справа; несовместимые (трудоголик и лентяй, жаворонок и сова…) вместе не бывают.
en: No traits — an ordinary person. Pick up to two on the right; incompatible ones (workaholic and lazybones, early bird and night owl…) can't go together.

keys: Уже выбраны две черты — снимите одну
en: Two traits already picked — remove one
no spaces (use a hyphen for double names)
Lots of small, quick orders — the best profile for learning.
We turn, mill and drill. Plenty of customers, small orders — you can grow at an easy pace.
Seasonal demand: orders soar in spring, winter is slack.
Machinery for collective farms and farmers. In spring you'll be run off your feet; in winter, stock up the warehouse and repair the machines.
Bulky products: it all comes down to the overhead crane and floor space. Few orders, but big ones.
We weld frames for hangars and workshops. The products are huge and heavy — without a crane and space you won't get far.
Hydrostatic testing and certification of every batch on the test bench.
Pumps for water utilities and gate valves for pipelines. Every unit goes under pressure on the bench.
+ forging and pressing, heat treatment, flaw detection
Big customers and very strict acceptance: any defect in a batch means a claim costing three times as much.
We work for the railway: they pay well and check everything. Defects are never forgiven.
All shops + a strong design bureau
Import substitution: machines for your own plant are 20% cheaper, state programs come more often. Long product cycle.
We build machine tools. You need almost the whole plant and an engineering department, but one machine is worth a hundred bushings.
All shops + security department and military acceptance
Steady money: a 50% advance on state contracts. But you need a checkpoint, deadlines are tight, inspections frequent, plus military acceptance.
Product 7T, assembly 12-K — what they are, you're not supposed to know. The state pays reliably, but it's a demanding customer.
Dust and static ruin the product; precision is a must.
A garage box in the industrial zone, an old lathe, three workers and {money}. Teaches the basics with step-by-step hints.

A bare plot by the highway, a site trailer, a crew of three builders and {money}. Support programs will help pay for construction — “Workshop from Scratch”, “Decent Amenities”, “Job Creation”: apply for them in Finance.
An empty plot, your own money and difficulty. A construction crew, everything unlocked from the start, no goals — build however you like.
A gentle mode for building: fewer and milder events, fines halved.
Standard: crises alternate with quiet weeks.
Hardcore: late payments, barter, corporate raiders, jumping prices, frequent inspections and theft.
Works 15% faster, but gets angry when there's nothing to do.
Works 15% slower and likes to linger.
Goes for a smoke every couple of hours. Gets cross if there's no ashtray bin.
Makes 40% fewer defects, but poor amenities upset him.
Comes in early. The night shift is torture for him (−10).
Enjoys the second shift (+6), nods off in the morning (−3).
Sometimes doesn't show up on Monday.
Gets hungry faster; lunch is sacred to him.
Worries twice as much about pay and is delighted by bonuses.
Learns one and a half times faster on courses and enjoys it; gains experience at the machine faster too.
Apprentices grow one and a half times faster under him, and he loses no speed himself. Teaching the young is a joy to him.
Gets on with people quickly: they make friends with him, not enemies.
Always bickering with someone: makes enemies faster than friends.
Always coming up with something: submits improvement proposals more often and gains experience faster.
Keeps to himself: makes friends and enemies half as fast.
A vocational school student on placement: gains experience twice as fast, gets a stipend instead of wages.
Carries off anything not nailed down: rod stock for the dacha, welding rods for a neighbour. Caught by the guards at the gate and by cameras.
Knows the Labour Code by heart. First to go to the union committee — and he'll lead the others.

en: The game is now in English, language is in Settings

en: Director is you: own office from day one

en: Search and highlighting of needed items in the build and objects menus

en: Helmets by position, new doors, lower wages

en: Faster: the city backdrop is drawn in chunks

keys: Звонки: главный инженер-советник подсказывает и напоминает
en: Phone calls: the chief engineer advises and reminds

keys: После проверок звонят инспекторы, по заказам — заказчики и депутат
en: Inspectors call after inspections; customers and the deputy call about orders

keys: Портреты с настроением и кабинеты у каждого персонажа
en: Mood portraits and an office for every character

keys: Свой курсор: оранжевая стрелка, над кнопками — светлая
en: Custom cursor: an orange arrow, light over buttons
